title: KestrelCare Benefits Review: Repeat Trip Interruption Claims
content:
**Rule.** A recent-trip share applies to a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts trip interruption reimbursement, counted from the trip interruption reimbursements already paid on the plan: one paid within the last six months means the recent-trip short share of 50 percent; one paid within the last twelve months but none within six months means the recent-trip long share of 75 percent; otherwise the whole amount.

The reimbursements counted are the trip interruption reimbursement entries on the plan's history, dated within the stated months counted back from the day of the new reimbursement. Rental car and towing reimbursements are not counted. The share multiplies the amount for the trip days.

| Earlier trip interruption reimbursements on the plan | Share paid |
|---|---|
| at least one in the last six months | 50 percent |
| none in six months, at least one in twelve | 75 percent |
| none in twelve months | 100 percent |

*Hypothetical:* an amount of 400.00 is paid at 200.00 when an earlier trip interruption was reimbursed four months before, at 300.00 when it was nine months before, and at 400.00 when none was reimbursed in the last year.
